generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with edit-target and style-reference inputs

lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: No directional cast-shadow field or sun angle is apparent, but several basalt faces retain light-top/dark-side value separation; the strict flat-face lighting rule therefore remains a visual failure risk.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median bounding-box width across 61 isolated dark-green conifer components, scaled by 2560/1254; this dark-core proxy can understate the full needle silhouette but still shows the generated crown scale is materially below contract.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: The broad central gold-green meadow, station-ground strip, and adjoining open shelf count as buildable; exposed coastal cliff faces and the waterfall brow count as steep; broken plateau, talus, outcrops, and tree stands make up the remainder.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Source-raster colour classification, connected-component selection, local cool-foam and wet-margin growth, morphological smoothing, and speckle-hole fill over the painted coast, surf, wash, stream, pool, and single fall; no polyline geometry.
water_mask.raster_component_note: One logical connected watercourse and coast includes separate visible raster components where dry channel stones and offshore basalt stacks occlude painted water; dry rock silhouettes are intentionally not classified as water.

source_scale_gate_reproduction.note: Radii 3 and 24 at 1254 px scale to approximately 6.12 and 49.00 px on the 2560 px canvas; the reproduction uses the repository blue-fringe predicate.

open_risks: Median isolated dark-green conifer components measure 38.788 px / 1.862 m at final canvas scale, materially below the required 84-147 px / 4-7 m range.

The generated east-coast footprint reaches 169 source pixels across the north edge and 84 across the south edge. The mask correctly includes those painted wet pixels, but the literal dry north/south edge constraint is not met.

Several coastal basalt runs remain ordered, with visible light-top/dark-side value separation. This conflicts with the irregular weathering and one-flat-value-per-face rules despite the key-light asymmetry proxy passing.
The long pale station meadow can read as a dirt road rather than purely treeless ground; owner visual review is required.
The official Node authoring gate was not run because managed execution denies node.exe; both water-fringe rings and lighting metrics were reproduced locally from the delivered rasters.
The generated result has not been visually approved by the owner.
